summary: PR #129 has 5 critical semantic regressions where the learning-loop rewrite to promote-then-prune was not propagated to several surviving kernel files (SKILL.md, handoffs.md, host.md, pack.md, CLAUDE.md), and 2 critical findings where the PR deletes agents/skills that are still referenced by surviving files. These are internal-consistency contradictions that will cause agent confusion at runtime.
goal: Review PR #129 for semantic regressions in the agent pipeline system

findings.issue: SKILL.md retro step contradicts the new learning-loop.md. SKILL.md says: 'fold new loop/learnings.jsonl entries into loop/learnings.md, promote any lesson seen 2+ times to a standing rule'. But the rewritten learning-loop.md defines a promote-then-prune pipeline where learnings.jsonl does not exist and learnings.md contains only open questions.
findings.fix: Update SKILL.md step 6 to match the promote-then-prune model in learning-loop.md: collect learnings from handoff arrays, promote each to its permanent file per the routing table, prune the entry.

findings.issue: SKILL.md prompt template tells agents to 'Append your new learnings to loop/learnings.jsonl AND put cross-agent findings in the handoff learnings array'. The new protocol (protocol.md, learning-loop.md, all updated agent files) tells agents to put learnings only in the handoff array; the orchestrator retro promotes them. This contradicts every updated agent file.
findings.fix: Update the prompt template to match the new protocol: agents put learnings in the handoff array only. Remove the learnings.jsonl reference.

findings.issue: handoffs.md says: 'Each learning here MUST also be appended (one line) to loop/learnings.jsonl.' The new learning-loop.md and all updated agent protocol blocks say agents put learnings only in the handoff; the orchestrator promotes them. This is a direct contradiction of the new protocol.
findings.fix: Remove the learnings.jsonl append instruction. Replace with: 'The orchestrator retro promotes these to the right permanent file -- see learning-loop.md.'

findings.issue: host.md lists 'Memory: loop/learnings.md + loop/learnings.jsonl' (line 18) and 'loop/learnings.md and loop/learnings.jsonl are persistent memory' (line 55). The new system has no learnings.jsonl -- learnings.md is only for open questions.
findings.fix: Update host.md to match the new system: Memory is 'loop/learnings.md (open questions only)'. Remove learnings.jsonl references.

findings.issue: pack.md references learnings.jsonl in three places (four layers diagram, 'what stays' list, and references agents/github.md and skills/github/SKILL.md which were deleted). Pack.md layer 4 says 'MEMORY loop/learnings.md + learnings.jsonl'. Line 81 says 'loop/learnings.md + loop/learnings.jsonl'. Lines 188-189 say 'see agents/github.md and skills/github/SKILL.md' -- both deleted.
findings.fix: Update pack.md: (1) replace learnings.jsonl references with the new model, (2) remove references to deleted agents/github.md and skills/github/SKILL.md.

findings.issue: CLAUDE.md says: 'Persist read-only agents learnings into loop/learnings.jsonl.' The new system has no learnings.jsonl. The orchestrator retro promotes learnings to permanent files.
findings.fix: Change line 90 to describe the new promote-then-prune system: 'The orchestrator retro promotes read-only agents learnings to the right permanent file.'

findings.issue: The handoff JSON schema description says: 'Cross-agent findings pinged at other agents; each is also appended to loop/learnings.jsonl'. The new protocol says learnings go in the handoff array only; the orchestrator promotes them.
findings.fix: Update the description to match the new protocol.

findings.issue: The programmatic orchestrator buildStagePrompt tells agents: 'Append new learnings to loop/learnings.jsonl and the handoff learnings array.' This contradicts the new protocol where agents only put learnings in the handoff array.
findings.fix: Update the stage prompt to match the new protocol: remove the learnings.jsonl instruction.

findings.issue: The orchestrator retro.ts code still reads/writes learnings.jsonl. The new learning-loop.md describes a promote-then-prune system that routes findings directly to permanent files (gates.md, context/*.md, agents/*.md) rather than accumulating in a jsonl ledger. The code and the docs describe different systems.
findings.fix: Either update retro.ts to implement the promote-then-prune pipeline described in learning-loop.md, or update learning-loop.md to describe what retro.ts actually does. The current state is contradictory.

findings.issue: SKILL.md prompt template says: 'read loop/learnings.md (your section + all)'. The new learning-loop.md says learnings.md has only open questions with no topic sections. There are no agent-specific sections to read.
findings.fix: Update to: 'read loop/learnings.md for open questions that may affect your work'.

findings.issue: pack.md references 'agents/github.md and skills/github/SKILL.md' but both agents/github.md and skills/github/SKILL.md were deleted in this PR.
context/git.md references 'skills/closed-loop/host.md' for review policy. host.md still exists but contains stale learnings.jsonl references (covered in critical finding above).
findings.fix: Addressed by fixing host.md per the critical finding.

findings.issue: Pack scripts still create and reference learnings.jsonl. init-pack.mjs creates an empty learnings.jsonl; pack-copy.mjs adds it to .gitignore negation; export-template.mjs writes it to template repos.
findings.fix: Update scripts to match the new system. Remove learnings.jsonl creation and references.

findings.issue: MANIFEST.json includes learnings.jsonl in the pack file list. SETUP.md file tree shows learnings.jsonl. These reference a file that no longer exists in the new system.
findings.fix: Remove learnings.jsonl from MANIFEST.json and SETUP.md file tree.

findings.issue: The .gitignore comment says 'loop/* with negation to keep learnings.md (open questions only)' which correctly reflects the new system, but the negation pattern also includes !loop/handoffs/ and !loop/*.md. The old system also needed !loop/learnings.jsonl but that negation was removed, which is correct.
findings.fix: No action needed -- just noting the .gitignore was correctly updated.

learnings.insight: When rewriting a cross-cutting protocol like learning-loop.md, every file that references the old protocol must be updated in the same change. The SKILL.md, handoffs.md, host.md, pack.md, CLAUDE.md, handoffs/schema.json, and orchestrator source code all still reference the old learnings.jsonl-based system.
learnings.action: Grep for every reference to the old system (learnings.jsonl, standing rules, 'your section + all', four-step protocol, fold/curate) before marking the rewrite complete.
